---
title: "Run all testthat tests"
author: "Grace Smith-Vidaurre"
date: "2023-01-05"
output: html_document
---

See more info on the testthat package: https://r-pkgs.org/testing-basics.html. See examples at: https://www.r-bloggers.com/2019/11/automated-testing-with-testthat-in-practice/.

```{r}

rm(list = ls())

# Install packages unless they already exist on the local machine
is_installed <- function(p) is.element(p, installed.packages()[,1])

# This vector of packages includes those used in the files called below
X <- c("testthat", "tidyverse", "plyr", "dplyr", "lubridate", "pbapply")

# Check that each of these packages is installed, and if not, then install them
invisible(lapply(1:length(X), function(x){
  if(!is_installed(X[x])){
    install.packages(X[x], repos = "http://lib.stat.cmu.edu/R/CRAN")
  }
}))

# Load testthat
library(testthat)

# These paths will need to be changed for different computers and/or users
testing_path <- "/Users/gsvidaurre/Desktop/GitHub_repos/ABISSMAL/R/tests/testthat/"
code_path <- "/Users/gsvidaurre/Desktop/GitHub_repos/ABISSMAL/R/"
testthat_tmp_path <- "/Users/gsvidaurre/Desktop"

# Run the testthat tests for each function
testthat::test_file(file.path(testing_path, "test_combine_raw_data.R"))

testthat::test_file(file.path(testing_path, "test_detect_perching_events.R"))

testthat::test_file(file.path(testing_path, "test_preprocess_detections.R"))

testthat::test_file(file.path(testing_path, "test_detect_clusters.R"))

testthat::test_file(file.path(testing_path, "test_score_clusters.R"))

```
